why_ai: Licensed dentists work hands-on in patients' mouths and carry malpractice liability personally.
why_clarity: Procedures follow clinical protocols on recurring cases, though restoration longevity shows years later.
why_digital: Care is delivered on a patient's body in a local operatory chosen face to face.

why_ai: Survey analysis is screen work AI accelerates; the association's brand carries the credibility.
why_clarity: Long-running surveys follow fixed methods, but projections are validated only years later.
why_digital: Survey data in, research reports published online.

why_ai: State-mandated licensure exams must be legally defensible, and only recognised bodies may set them.
why_clarity: Psychometric methods are codified, and item statistics give objective performance checks.
why_digital: Item data and practice analyses on screen, but exams are administered at centres and clinics.

why_ai: Named clinical educators sell their reputation, but published evidence lets AI generate generic content.
why_clarity: Curricula meet CE credit rules, but whether teaching changed clinical outcomes is rarely measured.
why_digital: Clinical content delivered online and in seminars, with some hands-on courses.

why_ai: Claim routing and scrubbing are rule automation, though payer connectivity keeps the intermediary needed.
why_clarity: Each claim is accepted or rejected against payer rules, millions of times over.
why_digital: Electronic claims and attachments in, routed submissions and analytics out.

why_ai: Analysing purchase line items into benchmarks and category plans is routine AI-friendly analytics.
why_clarity: Recurring category reviews use defined data, but plan quality shows only in later sales.
why_digital: Purchase data in, category plans and reports delivered on screen.

why_ai: FDA clearance and dentist-adjudicated ground truth protect them, but they compete with other AI.
why_clarity: Detection accuracy is measurable against adjudicated labels across millions of radiographs.
why_digital: Radiographs in, model outputs delivered as software to practices and payers.

why_ai: Restoration design from scans at industrial volume is what automated CAD design tools now do directly.
why_clarity: Designs follow standard steps at volume and are judged by whether the crown seats.
why_digital: Intraoral scans in, design files out, routinely done offshore.

why_ai: Prosthetics are physically fabricated and finished by hand, with denturists licensed to treat patients.
why_clarity: Fit is checkable, but shade and esthetics are judged by eye and taste.
why_digital: Mostly physical impressions in and physical prosthetics out, shipped between labs and practices.

why_ai: Independent physical testing and clinician field trials are the product, which AI cannot generate.
why_clarity: Lab protocols are standardised, but longevity results take years to arrive.
why_digital: Physical materials tested in labs and clinics, ratings sold as an online subscription.

why_ai: Licensed dental consultants must sign denials, but radiograph review is being automated by imaging AI.
why_clarity: Coverage rules and frequency limits are codified and applied to millions of similar claims.
why_digital: Claims, radiographs and narratives in, determinations and policy out, all on screen.

why_ai: Turning PMS data into benchmarks and coaching metrics is standard analytics that AI-native tools replicate.
why_clarity: Production, acceptance and reappointment metrics are defined and computed the same way repeatedly.
why_digital: Practice management data in, dashboards and benchmarks delivered online.

why_ai: Once-in-a-career sales depend on trusted advisors, contested valuations and private transaction comps.
why_clarity: Each practice sale is distinct and the valuation is contested rather than verified.
why_digital: Financial documents and valuations are screen work, but brokerage runs on regional relationships.

why_ai: Dental care is still delivered hands-on by licensed dentists, with a corporate layer above.
why_clarity: DSOs standardise clinical protocols across many locations repeating the same procedures.
why_digital: Care is in-person at local offices, with a corporate analytics and admin layer.

why_ai: Acquisition bets are high-stakes judgment, but modelling and benchmarking are screen analytics AI accelerates.
why_clarity: Productivity metrics are defined, but acquisition outcomes are known only years later.
why_digital: Clinical and production data in, models and reports produced on screen.

why_ai: The owner-dentist personally treats patients and is the relationship patients return for.
why_clarity: Preventive and restorative procedures follow protocols and recur daily.
why_digital: Hands-on care in a local office found through referrals and proximity.

why_ai: Structured benefit lookups from payer portals and calls are exactly what AI agents automate.
why_clarity: Fixed inputs and outputs per patient, repeated for every appointment, checkable against claims.
why_digital: Patient and payer data in, coverage breakdowns out via portals and phone.

why_ai: Licensed dentists treat Medicaid patients hands-on; patients choose by plan access more than relationship.
why_clarity: High-volume standard procedures under codified state coverage rules.
why_digital: In-person clinical care at local practices and FQHCs.

why_ai: Licensed dentists treat patients hands-on in vans at schools, nursing homes and prisons.
why_clarity: Batch preventive care follows protocols and repeats across sites.
why_digital: Physical care delivered on site, arranged through local institutional contracts.

why_ai: Board-certified specialists treat children hands-on, managing behaviour and sedation that parents trust them with.
why_clarity: Procedures are protocol-based, but behaviour management varies by child and practitioner.
why_digital: In-person care in local offices chosen by parents through referrals.

why_ai: Statutory authority to license and discipline cannot be delegated to software.
why_clarity: Procedures are set in statute, but complaint adjudication is case by case and contested.
why_digital: Applications and complaint records are documents, but the board is a state monopoly.

why_ai: Costs come from structured data AI can package, though persuasion still happens in person.
why_clarity: Out-of-pocket math is exact and acceptance or decline is known at the appointment.
why_digital: Structured data in, but the presentation is often a chairside conversation.
